description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.5 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release adds an optional Stop Story auto-advance patch and a switch that keeps your place when you return to the feed within ten minutes. The settings page has clearer groups and a stronger status header. Hide Reels in the feed catches more carousel rows.

21 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your browser, media can be saved, and you can choose an AMOLED black or Material You theme.

Validation: 389 runtime tests passed locally. All 115 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 21 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes. Story timing still needs a signed-in device check; its patch starts off in Morphe Manager.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
